notes: Scan progress now shows a percentage instead of a moving stripe.
patch_notes: The scan progress bar now shows a real percentage. Before scanning, the app does a quick counting pass over the folders it is about to scan, then the bar fills from 0% to 100% as files are checked. The live 'files checked' counter is still there, now with the percentage next to it. The bar stops just below 100% while the duplicate check runs and reaches full when the scan actually finishes.
